cleaner: remove fenced code blocks with re.S; replace [#*_`|=<>\]+ by space; collapse whitespace; strip
file_concatenation_order: lexicographic relative path independently for train and validation streams
start_rule: round(i*(n_tokens-block)/(windows-1)); all starts must be unique
fail_fast: validation gate may be evaluated before materializing train files; train materialization occurs only if validation conditions pass
